Overview_Subtitle: DesktopFlow watches the folders you choose and moves new files into the structure you approve.
Overview_Never: No files have been organized yet.
Empty_Storage: Storage details appear after the desktop folder can be read.
Folder_DesktopSubtitle: Files sitting directly on the desktop. Folders, shortcuts, and protected files stay where they are.
Folder_DownloadsSubtitle: Files sitting directly in Downloads. This folder uses its own rules and can be turned off on its own.
Organizer_Subtitle: Folder names become real directories. Existing files are not reshuffled when you rename a folder.
Organizer_Hint: Use a relative folder such as Documents/PDF. Paths that leave the monitored folder are rejected.
Rules_Subtitle: Custom rules run before the built-in file types. A lower priority number wins.
Rules_Empty: No custom rules yet. File types still follow the organizer folders.
Conflict_Same: {0} and {1} can match the same file and have the same priority.
Activity_Subtitle: Every move, undo, and recovery is stored on this PC.
Settings_Subtitle: DesktopFlow stores these choices on this PC and does not require an account.
Settings_LanguageNote: Menus and pages change immediately. Some Windows controls follow the Windows display language.
Settings_Tray: Keep running in the notification area when the window closes
Settings_Delay: Wait for a file to finish writing (milliseconds)
Settings_Exclusions: Never move files matching these names (one pattern per line)
Settings_OverwriteNote: This protection stays on. A file with the same name gets a numbered name instead.
Settings_OpenSource: DesktopFlow is free software under the MIT license.
Setup_WelcomeBody: DesktopFlow organizes files on your desktop and in Downloads. It never deletes a file and it never overwrites one. Nothing is moved until you ask.
Setup_FoldersBody: Watching a folder does not move the files already there. You can turn each folder on or off later.
Setup_PrefsBody: The desktop uses a detailed set of folders. Downloads uses a simpler set. You can rename both after setup.
Setup_BehaviorBody: Leave automatic organization off if you want to approve every organize action yourself. You can change this later.
Setup_PreviewBody: This is a count of what would move today. DesktopFlow has not moved anything.
Setup_DoneBody: You can organize the desktop now, or leave the files where they are and organize them later.
Dialog_Alternate: The original name is already used. Restore the file with a numbered name instead?
Dialog_SelectFiles: Select at least one file that can be moved.
Validation_Value: Enter the value this rule should match.
Validation_Folder: Choose a folder inside the monitored directory.
Validation_Path: That folder could not be found.
Validation_Extensions: Enter at least one extension, such as .pdf.
Message_StartupBlocked: Windows did not enable startup. You can turn it on from Settings > Apps > Startup.
Storage_Subtitle: See which drives, folders, and file types use the most space, and which files are exact copies. Windows, paging files, and the Recycle Bin are left out. Links are not followed. Nothing is deleted.
Storage_Ready: Drive space is shown immediately. Scan to measure folders and duplicate files.
Storage_Done: Scanned {0} files ({1}). {2} duplicate groups, {3} used by extra copies. {4} locations were skipped.
Storage_NoDrives: No fixed drives could be read.
Storage_ScanPrompt: Scan this PC to fill this list. Windows system locations stay out of the results.
Storage_NoFolders: No folders outside Windows system locations were measured.
Storage_NoTypes: No files outside Windows system locations were measured.
Storage_MoreDuplicates: {0} more duplicate groups are not shown. The largest ones are listed.
